title: JustRUA: A Controlled Study of GPT-6 Robot-Use Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.16009v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: GPT-6 Astra can drive a robot arm directly through a fixed harness, and scores of such robot-use agents on RoboDojo have risen quickly since. Reported systems differ in harness and test subset and often change several designs at once, so it is hard to tell which choices produce the gains. We take these designs apart and test them in one framework, along the harness around the model, the action interface, the reuse of experience and the scene geometry given to the model. A lean harness that keeps the full episode history and stops each motion early goes a long way. Reusing experience changes how the model acts but is not a free lunch, and scene geometry helps most, even when depth is predicted from RGB alone. JustRUA starts from the official L3 harness and keeps only what matters most. Even with no learned policy, self-improvement loop or task-specific tuning, this simple harness raises the score on the RoboDojo simulation benchmark sub

translated_title: JustRUA：GPT-6 机器人使用智能体的对照研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.16009v1 公告类型：交叉（cross）。摘要：GPT-6 Astra 可以通过固定的线束直接驱动机器人手臂，此后此类机器人使用智能体在 RoboDojo 上的分数迅速攀升。但已报告的系统在线束和测试子集上各不相同，且往往同时改动多个设计，因此很难判断究竟是哪些选择带来了性能提升。我们将这些设计逐一拆解，并在同一框架下进行测试，涵盖围绕模型的线束、动作接口、经验复用以及提供给模型的场景几何信息。一个精简的线束——保留完整的回合历史并在每个动作早期即行终止——就已大有帮助。经验复用会改变模型的行为方式，但并非免费午餐；而场景几何信息的帮助最大，即使深度仅由 RGB 预测得到也是如此。JustRUA 从官方 L3 线束出发，只保留最关键的部分。即使不使用学习策略、自我改进循环或任务特定微调，这一简单线束也能在 RoboDojo 仿真基准子集上提升分数（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文通过对照实验系统拆解了 GPT-6 机器人使用智能体的各项设计选择，发现精简线束与场景几何信息贡献最大，并据此提出仅保留关键要素的简单框架 JustRUA，在 RoboDojo 仿真基准上显著提升分数。
en_tdlr: Through controlled experiments dissecting design choices for GPT-6 robot-use agents, this paper finds that a lean harness and scene geometry matter most, and proposes JustRUA—a simple harness keeping only what matters—that raises scores on the RoboDojo simulation benchmark.
